zh.lead: 今天最大的产品消息：OpenClaw 正式发布 v2026.11.10，加入默认可用的 Deep Research、可选的 Knowledge 知识库，以及遇到登录或验证码时的浏览器交接；与此同时，x.ai 官方 changelog 终于写出 Grok Bot v1.3.0。

important.title: 重要消息
items: Anthropic 于 11 月 25 日发文，介绍把对外 Messages API 从 Python 迁到 Rust：官方称每请求 CPU 约降 70%，中位首 token 时间约快 20%。他们把仍在线的生产服务当成校验器，对照流量找差异，再派 Claude 智能体去修复，全程没有停机。
OpenClaw 在北京时间昨日下午发布稳定版 v2026.11.10，同日稍早还有补丁版 v2026.11.9。重点是默认可用的 Deep Research、可选的 Knowledge 本地知识库，以及遇到登录或验证码时的浏览器交接。
Grok Bot 官方 changelog 的 Latest 已更新为 v1.3.0，标注日期 11 月 24 日。昨日早报时 changelog 仍停在 v1.2.3，只在 Homebrew 看到 1.3.0；今天官方说明已经补上，主打更完整的 Slack 协作、到货提醒和组织域管控。
Claude 官方账号在 Fable 5.2 发布两周后汇总了社区作品；DeepMind 展示了 Gemini 4 Neon 在 Antigravity 里做的街机装置。CursorBench 4.1 较昨日无更新。

sections.title: 实验室与工程
sections.body: Anthropic 写道，Messages API 是客户以及 Claude Code、Cowork 等自家应用调用 Claude 的主要入口，日均请求大约增长了 1,800 倍。Claude 大约用一周写出核心请求路径的第一版，但校验比生成更难。他们没有停留在只改热点路径——那次增量改写只把 CPU 降了约 8%–10%。新博客的重点，是如何把生产 API 本身变成校验器，并自动派智能体修差异。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: OpenClaw 的 v2026.11.9 是小补丁；v2026.11.10 才是功能大版。Hermes Agent 稳定版仍为 v0.23.4，昨夜仅新增一条 canary。codex 稳定版仍为 0.172.0，实验线已到 0.174.0-alpha.6，但发行说明只有版本号。DeepSeek Harness 无新标签。Cursor changelog 自 11 月 6 日以来仍无新条目。另补记：Claude 在 11 月 24 日已将 Skills over MCP 对 Pro / Max / Ultra 开放公开测试，昨日早报未写入，故今日补上。

sections.title: 论文与演示
sections.body: alphaXiv 首页靠前的是多智能体论文《Recursive Collective Intelligence》：在同等计算预算下，衡量群体互动是否真比独立采样更强。此前靠前的 VOPD 仍在，浏览量升至约 2,000 次；新进入视线的还有讨论“睡眠”式缓存精炼的论文。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: Karpathy、Andrew Ng、Meta 近一日无新帖。水木主题列表已抓到，但帖文正文未打开，摘要未编造讨论细节。港股今早采集时尚未开盘。

en.lead: Today’s biggest product news: OpenClaw shipped v2026.11.10, with Deep Research on by default, an optional Knowledge vault, and browser handoff when a sign-in or CAPTCHA appears; x.ai has also finally published official Grok Bot v1.3.0 notes on the changelog.

important.title: Highlights
items: On November 25, Anthropic described moving its public Messages API from Python to Rust. Officially, CPU per request fell by about 70% and median time to first token by about 20%. They used the still-live production service as a verifier, compared differences on production traffic, and dispatched Claude agents to fix them, without taking the service offline or freezing feature work.

OpenClaw published stable v2026.11.10 yesterday afternoon, Beijing time, after a same-day patch, v2026.11.9. The 11.10 highlights are Deep Research (walk-away multi-source retrieval with cited reports that flag disagreements and gaps), an optional local Knowledge vault, and browser handoff.

The official Grok Bot changelog’s Latest is now v1.3.0, dated November 24, titled “Smarter Slack Bots, restock alerts, org controls.” In yesterday’s briefing the changelog was still on v1.2.3, with only Homebrew showing 1.3.0; the official notes have now caught up.

The official Claude account marked two weeks of Fable 5.2 with a roundup of community work, and DeepMind showed a 1980s-arcade Rube Goldberg machine that Gemini 4 Neon coded in Antigravity. CursorBench 4.1 is unchanged versus yesterday.

sections.title: Labs and engineering
sections.body: Anthropic says the Messages API is the main way customers — and its own apps, such as Claude Code and Cowork — reach Claude. From early 2024 to fall 2026, average daily requests on its platform grew about 1,800 times. Claude wrote a first version of the core request path in about a week, but verification was harder than generation: the Python service kept changing, model outputs are nondeterministic, and customer requests could not be read. They did not stop at a hot-path rewrite — that incremental step cut CPU by only about 8%–10% and made each token cross between Python and Rust three times. The new post is about turning the production API itself into a verifier and dispatching agents to close the gaps. Karpathy, Andrew Ng, and Meta had no new posts in the past day.

sections.title: Products
sections.body: OpenClaw v2026.11.9 is a small patch for prompt caching on forked sessions, Tool Search compatibility, Claude CLI / ACP reply delivery, headed Chrome screenshots, and safer redirects; v2026.11.10 is the feature release. Official notes for Grok Bot v1.3.0 cover richer Slack collaboration (handoffs coming back in a DM, sharing a thread reply to a channel on request, waking a bot by name in a group DM, and more), restock alerts for sold-out items, org limits on connecting accounts to the organization’s own domains, and several purchase and approval improvements. Hermes Agent’s stable release remains v0.23.4, already covered yesterday; a new canary, canary.20261125T064800Z-v0.23.4, appeared last night without a separate feature list. Codex stable is still 0.172.0; the experimental line has reached 0.174.0-alpha.6 with version-only notes. DeepSeek Harness has no new tag and remains dsh-v0.2.3-alpha.2 from November 22. The Cursor changelog still has no new entry since November 6. A catch-up note: on November 24 Claude opened Skills over MCP as a public beta for Pro, Max, and Ultra, with Tasks and Elicitation generally available; that was missing from yesterday’s briefing, so it is recorded here and not treated as a same-day launch.

sections.title: Papers and demos
sections.body: Near the top of the alphaXiv homepage is the multi-agent paper Recursive Collective Intelligence, which uses an equal-budget ladder to test whether group interaction truly beats independent sampling, and whether a group can improve its next generation from its own verified work. Yesterday’s leader VOPD is still there, now at about 2,000 views. Newly prominent is Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep, on refining a context cache offline in a sleep-like pass so models can adapt in context from fewer examples.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: Karpathy, Andrew Ng, and Meta had no new posts in the past day. Some blog and paper pages had no usable images to mirror. The NewSMTH Child Education board list was collected, but post bodies may still be behind a read-verification gate, so summaries do not invent discussion details. The Hong Kong cash market had not yet opened at collection time this morning.

title.zh: 把 Messages API 迁到 Rust
title.en: Migrating our Messages API to Rust

summary.zh: 11 月 25 日，Anthropic 介绍 Messages API 从 Python 迁到 Rust 的经过。这篇对外 API 是客户和 Claude Code、Cowork 等应用的主要入口；从 2024 年初到 2026 年秋，日均请求大约增长 1,800 倍。Claude 大约用一周写出核心请求路径的第一版，但校验是难点：生产服务仍在改、输出不确定、也不能直接看客户请求。他们把仍在线的生产 API 当成校验器，对照流量找差异，并自动派智能体修复。官方称新实现每请求 CPU 约降 70%，中位首 token 时间约快 20%，而且没有停机，也没有冻结功能开发。
summary.en: On November 25, Anthropic described moving the Messages API from Python to Rust. This public API is the main way customers — and apps such as Claude Code and Cowork — reach Claude; average daily requests grew about 1,800 times from early 2024 to fall 2026. Claude wrote a first version of the core request path in about a week, but verification was the hard part: the production service kept changing, outputs are nondeterministic, and customer requests could not be read. They turned the still-live production API into a verifier, compared differences on live traffic, and automatically dispatched agents to fix them. Officially, the new implementation uses about 70% less CPU per request and cuts median time to first token by about 20%, without downtime or a feature freeze.

title.zh: 递归的集体智能：同等预算梯子上的多智能体涌现
title.en: Recursive Collective Intelligence: Emergence on an Equal-Budget Ladder in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

summary.zh: Fang Wu、Liwei Jiang、Manling Li、李飞飞、Leonidas Guibas、Gordon Wetzstein、Yejin Choi 和 Yining Hong 提出用“同等预算梯子”评估多智能体系统：不只比较是否强过单个智能体，还要在计算量对齐的条件下，对比多数投票和 pass@n，从而判断互动本身有没有让群体更强，以及群体能否用自己已验证的工作改进下一代。论文标注提交于 11 月 24 日，目前出现在 alphaXiv 首页靠前位置，约 219 次浏览，标注为 1 天前。
summary.en: Fang Wu, Liwei Jiang, Manling Li, Li Fei-Fei, Leonidas Guibas, Gordon Wetzstein, Yejin Choi, and Yining Hong propose an equal-budget ladder for multi-agent systems: beyond beating a single agent, a group is graded against compute-matched majority vote and pass@n, to test whether interaction itself makes the group smarter and whether it can improve its next generation from its own verified work. The paper is marked as submitted on November 24 and currently sits near the top of the alphaXiv homepage, with about 219 views, labeled 1 day ago.

title.zh: 可验证的 On-Policy 蒸馏
title.en: Verifiable On-Policy Distillation

summary.zh: Juntong Shi、Stefano Ermon、Jure Leskovec 和 Minkai Xu 提出 VOPD：把稀疏的可验证奖励，转化成对教师模型密集反馈的约束，从而在学生自己采样的回复上更好学习数学推理。该文昨日已出现在首页最前，今日仍靠前，浏览量升至约 2,000 次，标注为 2 天前。
summary.en: Juntong Shi, Stefano Ermon, Jure Leskovec, and Minkai Xu propose VOPD, which turns sparse verifiable rewards into a constraint on dense teacher feedback, so language models can learn mathematical reasoning more effectively from student-generated responses. It led the homepage yesterday and remains near the top today, now at about 2,000 views, labeled 2 days ago.

title.zh: 通过“睡眠”实现更省样本的上下文内适应
title.en: Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep

summary.zh: Sangyun Lee 与 Zhang Enyan 等人讨论：在处理一段上下文后，用额外的前向计算精炼保留下来的 KV 缓存，帮助语言模型用更少的上下文例子完成适应。预印本摘要还写到，在留出的代码评测上，睡眠轮次 N=2 和 N=4 的模型，分别用约 2.10 倍和 2.39 倍更少的上下文 token 追上无睡眠基线的损失。该文出现在今日首页靠前位置，约 3,000 次浏览，标注为 2 天前。摘要依据公开摘要撰写，未编造其他实验数字。
summary.en: Sangyun Lee, Zhang Enyan, and colleagues discuss refining a retained KV cache with extra forward passes after a chunk of context, so language models can adapt in context from fewer examples. The preprint abstract also reports that, on held-out code, models with sleep rounds N=2 and N=4 matched the no-sleep baseline’s loss using about 2.10× and 2.39× fewer in-context tokens, respectively. It appears near the top of today’s homepage, with about 3,000 views, labeled 2 days ago. This summary follows the public abstract and does not invent other experimental numbers.

summary.zh: 昨日 13:42（北京时间）正式发布 v2026.11.10，接替同日 08:47 的补丁版 v2026.11.9，以及前日的 v2026.11.8。11.10 的亮点包括：Deep Research 在便携引擎上默认可用，可用现有模型和网络工具做多源检索并生成带引用的报告，来源冲突时会并列摘录并标出未决问题，任务也可在 Gateway 重启后恢复；Knowledge 是可选的本地 Markdown 知识库，需在设置里把记忆提供者改成 Knowledge，才能把对话、会议和文件整理成可浏览的人物、项目与决策页；浏览器交接则允许在登录、验证码或敏感表单处由人接管标签页，再把控制交回智能体。v2026.11.9 则是小补丁，改善分叉会话提示缓存、Tool Search 兼容、Claude CLI 与 ACP 回复投递、有头 Chrome 后台标签截图，以及自建网络工具的跳转主机限制。extended-stable / LTS 仍为 v2026.10.33。
summary.en: v2026.11.10 was formally published at 13:42 Beijing time yesterday, succeeding same-day patch v2026.11.9 (08:47) and the previous day’s v2026.11.8. Highlights in 11.10 include Deep Research, enabled by default on the portable engine, which uses your existing model and web tools for multi-source retrieval and cited reports, places conflicting quotes side by side, marks unresolved questions, and can resume across Gateway restarts; Knowledge, an optional local Markdown vault that, once selected as the memory provider, turns conversations, meetings, and files into browsable pages for people, projects, and decisions; and browser handoff, which lets a person take over a tab for a sign-in, CAPTCHA, or sensitive form and then return control to the agent. v2026.11.9 is a smaller patch for prompt caching on forked sessions, Tool Search compatibility, Claude CLI and ACP reply delivery, headed Chrome screenshots of background tabs, and redirect-host restrictions for self-hosted web tools. extended-stable / LTS remains v2026.10.33.

A catch-up on the November 24 product update, which was missing from yesterday’s briefing: Skills over MCP is in public beta in Claude and Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Ultra, on by default, and available to Team once an admin enables it; Tasks and Elicitation are generally available, and File Uploads is coming soon. The official account last night rounded up community work from the first two weeks of Fable 5.2. The Anthropic newsroom is still pinned to Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 from November 9.

summary.zh: 官方 changelog Latest 已更新为 v1.3.0，标注日期 2026-11-24，标题为「Smarter Slack Bots, restock alerts, org controls」。昨日早报时 Latest 仍是 11 月 18 日的 v1.2.3，当时只在 Homebrew cask 看到 1.3.0。今日已对照官方说明：Slack 侧包括跨 Bot 任务结果回到你的私信并带上 Connect 按钮、可按请求把线程回复发到频道、在群组私信里被点名即醒来、私密对话中的转发保持在原对话等；购物侧为售罄商品提供到货提醒；组织可限制成员只连接本组织域名下的账号。此外还有邮件草稿支持密送、账户设备列表、以及多项购买审批和 Slack 回复风格的改进。
summary.en: The official changelog’s Latest is now v1.3.0, dated November 24, 2026, titled “Smarter Slack Bots, restock alerts, org controls.” In yesterday’s briefing the Latest was still v1.2.3 from November 18, when only the Homebrew cask showed 1.3.0. Official notes now say: on Slack, work handed to another Bot comes back in your DM with a Connect button, a thread reply can be shared to the channel on request, saying a Bot’s name in a group DM wakes it, and a forward from a private conversation stays there; sold-out product cards offer a restock alert; and an organization can limit members to connecting accounts on its own domains. The notes also add Bcc on email drafts, a list of devices on the account, and several improvements to purchase approvals and Slack reply style.

text.en: Thursday focus (sanitized): on the work side, put together the current Xiaoai Plus security baseline as input for security-architecture work at month-end; also review how cloud defect density is calculated, and refresh working definitions of Session, Context, Turn, and Step. Streaming speech-recognition integration remains a priority. On the learning side, continue the technical-article reading and pstack. The general-education course (Wan Weigang’s thinking tools) stays in progress. Today is also the optional run day.
